newsitem.title: USA: Judge urges mediation in Marvel dispute.
newsitem.headline: Judge urges mediation in Marvel dispute.

text.p: A judge on Tuesday told Marvel Entertainment Group Inc, its banks, and bondholders of Marvel Holdings Inc that he would arrange, at their request, for a mediator to help settle their dispute over who controls the assets of the bankrupt companies.
Judge Roderick McKelvie of the US District Court in Delaware told both sides to "give (him) a letter as soon as possible" indicating their interest in mediation.
The judge also said he would rule later on how best to untangle a series of competing legal motions so that he could hold a hearing on June 19.
The June 19 hearing, he said, will be on the underlying dispute between the bondholders and the banks should the mediation fail.
